Metrics.Name: entra.users.population
Metrics.Description: Entra users jointly sliced by user_type and account_enabled (e.g. disabled guests), one series per combination.

Metrics.Name: entra.users.stale.total
Metrics.Description: Count of Entra users whose last sign-in is older than threshold_days. Requires Entra ID P1 or P2 (signInActivity).

Metrics.Name: entra.users.total
Metrics.Description: Total Entra users, independently sliced by account_enabled, user_type, and on_premises_sync_enabled.
